segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The half-played hand goes back into the deck. This one comes down to quick fingers: Wren tries to work a better card loose as the dealer cuts. His eyes never leave her hands, and the card she palms is a three. The house takes the twenty.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Quick fingers, madam, but this table has watched quicker ones and buried them all. Tired of counting, you said? Then perhaps you are tired of losing as well. Another round, or will you rest those clever hands?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: Another round, or will you rest
